title: 第25章 得赶紧搬家才行第26章 一柄断剑
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
结果一出门发现租住的小院不少人探着脑袋到处嗅闻。
他一时没反应过来，随即想起是早饭散发的香味惹得大家好奇。
来自异界的食材香气实在是太诱人了。
“看来，得赶紧搬家才行啊！”
童元安无奈地摇了摇头。
然后他就去了楼顶阳台。
拿出后土送他的令牌。
注入灵气后从空间里取出一块沉香木，朝魔都方向飞去。
不一会儿，他就到了目的地。
这里位于上海最繁华的核心商务区，寸土寸金。
九州拍卖行总部就在一栋五层木制古建筑内，外表装饰华丽且古典雅致。
正中间的大牌匾写着五个大字：九州拍卖行。
“这拍卖行还真有钱。”
童元安小声说了一句。
给罗庆书打电话不到一分钟，只见他气喘吁吁跑了过来。
“你好！
你就是童元安兄弟吧，我是罗庆书，请随我来。”
进了会客室，没等对方说什么话，童元安直接就把带来的东西展示出来。
“这！”
罗庆书惊讶出声。

除了这块木材巨大以外，更重要的是它散放出的气息让人陶醉。
质量绝对比预想要好得多。
看着童元安手里随意把玩着那么一大块珍贵木头，罗庆书都心疼不已。
要知道这玩意儿每克都很值钱啊，这么一大块价值起码数千万。
而它现在竟然成了玩具。
交谈期间，一个带着金色眼镜的老者走了进来。
他看上去超凡脱俗，一副世外高人的样子。
罗庆书连忙起身做介绍。
“这是咱们这儿的首席鉴定大师，同时也是国内知名专家。
曹老师，请您帮忙鉴定一下这块沉香木。”
即便罗庆书语气恭维十足，曹老师都没多瞧他一眼，直接坐到茶桌旁悠闲地喝起了茶。
“沉香木吗？家族传下来的吧，有多大呀，我还忘记带放大镜了。”
content_en:
结果一出门发现租住的小院不少人探着脑袋到处嗅闻。
他一时没反应过来，随即想起是早饭散发的香味惹得大家好奇。
The aroma of ingredients from another world is so tempting.
"It seems that we have to move quickly!"
Tong Yuanan shook his head helplessly.
Then he went to the rooftop balcony.
Take out the token Hou Tu gave him.
After injecting spiritual energy, he took out a piece of agarwood from the space and flew towards the Magic City.
After a while, he arrived at his destination.
This is located in the most prosperous core business district of Shanghai, where every inch of land is at a premium.
The headquarters of Kyushu Auction House is located in a five-story wooden ancient building with a gorgeously decorated and classically elegant exterior.
The large plaque in the middle reads five characters: Jiuzhou Auction House.
"This auction house is really rich."
Tong Yuanan whispered.
给罗庆书打电话不到一分钟，只见他气喘吁吁跑了过来。
"Hello!
You must be brother Tong Yuanan, I am Luo Qingshu, please come with me. "
After entering the reception room, Tong Yuanan directly showed what he had brought without waiting for the other party to say anything.
"This!"
Luo Qingshu was surprised.
In addition to the huge size of this piece of wood, more importantly, the smell it emits is intoxicating.
The quality is definitely much better than expected.
Seeing Tong Yuanan casually playing with such a large piece of precious wood in his hand, Luo Qingshu felt heartbroken.
You must know that every gram of this stuff is very valuable. Such a large piece is worth at least tens of millions.
And now it has become a toy.
During the conversation, an old man with golden glasses walked in.
He looked otherworldly, like a master from this world.
Luo Qingshu quickly stood up to make introductions.
"This is our chief appraiser here, and he is also a well-known expert in the country.
Teacher Cao, please help me identify this piece of agarwood. "
Even though Luo Qingshu's tone was full of compliments, Teacher Cao didn't even look at him. He sat down at the tea table and drank tea leisurely.
"Is it agarwood? It must have been passed down from the family. It's so big. I even forgot to bring a magnifying glass."
